svg.title: How an entry connects a problem to its proof
svg.desc: A problem, in the reader's words, is solved by a capability, in relate's words. The capability is covered by guides, recipes and reference pages, and verified by one recorded run: a cell on a recipe or a docs page, a language sample, or a CLI step, which the checks replay against its recording.
